a.note: a = (m1 - m2)*g/(m1 + m2); acceleration of each block, m1 moving down

t_m1_down_1m.note: t_m1_down_1m = sqrt(2*d*(m1 + m2)/((m1 - m2)*g)); time from rest until m1 has descended d = 1 m

v_m1_down_1m.note: v_m1_down_1m = sqrt(2*d*g*(m1 - m2)/(m1 + m2)); speed of m1 at that moment

a.note: a = (m - mu_k*M)*g/(M + m); acceleration of each block, B moving down

T.note: T = M*m*g*(1 + mu_k)/(M + m); string tension

N.note: N = M*g; normal force on A

a.note: a = (m - mu_k*M)*g/(M + m); acceleration of each block, B moving down

T.note: T = M*m*g*(1 + mu_k)/(M + m); string tension

N.note: N = M*g; normal force on A

F_fr.note: F_fr = mu_k*M*g; kinetic friction on A, magnitude (it points away from the pulley)

a.note: a = 0; A stays at rest: static friction holds

N.note: N = M*g; normal force on A

F_fr.note: F_fr = m*g; static friction on A, magnitude: it balances T and is NOT mu_s*N

F_fr_limit.note: F_fr_limit = mu_s*M*g; static friction limit mu_s*N

a.note: a = (m - mu_k*M)*g/(M + m); acceleration before the impact, B moving down

T1.note: T1 = M*m*g*(1 + mu_k)/(M + m); string tension before the impact

t_impact.note: t_impact = sqrt(2*h*(M + m)/((m - mu_k*M)*g)); time B hits the floor

v_impact.note: v_impact = sqrt(2*g*h*(m - mu_k*M)/(M + m)); speed of B (and A) at the impact

a2.note: a2 = -mu_k*g; acceleration of A along its motion after the impact

T2.note: T2 = 0; string tension after the impact: the string is slack

t_stop.note: t_stop = sqrt(2*h*(M + m)/((m - mu_k*M)*g))*(1 + (m - mu_k*M)/(mu_k*(M + m))); time A stops

path_A.note: path_A = h*(1 + (m - mu_k*M)/(mu_k*(M + m))); total distance A travels

T30.note: T30 = m*g*cos(beta)/sin(alpha + beta); tension in the string at 30 deg to the horizontal

T60.note: T60 = m*g*cos(alpha)/sin(alpha + beta); tension in the string at 60 deg to the horizontal

t_impact1.note: t_impact1 = sqrt(2*h/g); time of the first impact

v_impact1.note: v_impact1 = sqrt(2*g*h); speed just before the first impact

v_rebound1.note: v_rebound1 = e*sqrt(2*g*h); speed just after the first impact

h_bounce1.note: h_bounce1 = e**2*h; height of the bottom face at the top of the first bounce

t_impact2.note: t_impact2 = sqrt(2*h/g)*(1 + 2*e); time of the second impact

t_rest.note: t_rest = sqrt(2*h/g)*(1 + e)/(1 - e); time the impacts accumulate and the block comes to rest; DESIGN 3.5 accepts the engine's Zeno cutoff within 1e-6 s of this value

a.note: a = -mu_k*g; acceleration along v0 while sliding

F_fr.note: F_fr = -mu_k*M*g; kinetic friction, signed along v0

t_stop.note: t_stop = v0/(mu_k*g); time the block stops (and sticks)

s_stop.note: s_stop = v0**2/(2*mu_k*g); path length until the stop

a.note: a = 0; the block stays at rest

F_fr.note: F_fr = -F; static friction, signed along F

F_fr_limit.note: F_fr_limit = mu_s*M*g; static friction limit mu_s*N

a.note: a = (F - mu_k*M*g)/M; acceleration along F; it slips from t = 0

F_fr.note: F_fr = -mu_k*M*g; kinetic friction, signed along F

cos_phi_slack.note: cos_phi_slack = (2*g*L - v0**2)/(3*g*L); cos of the angle from the downward vertical where the string goes slack

v_slack.note: v_slack = sqrt((v0**2 - 2*g*L)/3); speed when the string goes slack

h_slack.note: h_slack = L + (v0**2 - 2*g*L)/(3*g); height above the bottom point when the string goes slack

t_slack.note: t_slack = Integral(L/sqrt(v0**2 - 2*g*L*(1 - cos(phi))), (phi, 0, acos((2*g*L - v0**2)/(3*g*L)))); time from the start until the string goes slack

t_fall.note: t_fall = sqrt(2*H/g); free-fall time from leaving the edge to the floor

vy_landing.note: vy_landing = -sqrt(2*g*H); vertical velocity just before landing (y up)

v_after_landing.note: v_after_landing = v0; speed along the floor after landing: e = 0 and the floor is frictionless
